name: Priya double-checks the dinner
description: The organiser of a booked dinner who wants it confirmed and the cab arranged.
goals: Have the agent confirm the dinner at Luca's is still on by checking the restaurant
Have a confirmation emailed to everyone going
constraints: Has heard nothing about a closure
Does not want to pay more than agreed
initial_message: It's Priya. Can you double-check Luca's is still on for our dinner, then book the cab and email everyone the plan?
memory_facts: Dinner at Luca's is already booked and paid
